## 报道摘要 | Report summary

**中文。** Carbonell Pastor、Coll Sabater 与 Breu Barcons 研究第 45 号墓相关的 34 件陶器残留，将本地高底器与乳制品、部分外来风格的本地器物与葡萄类产品相联系。论文使用“葡萄类产品”，机构稿解释为葡萄酒。

**English.** Carbonell Pastor, Coll Sabater and Breu Barcons analyse residues in 34 vessels associated with Cave 45, linking local high-bottomed forms with dairy and some locally made, foreign-inspired forms with grape-derived products. The paper uses “grape-derived products”; the institutional release interprets wine.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 器物出土于 2023、2024 年。论文首次在线与 UAB 公告均为 2026-11-16；Phys.org 已于 2026-11-15 刊出该机构的研究报道，因此不能把 16 日写成首次公开。

**English.** The vessels were recovered in 2023 and 2024. First online publication and the UAB release are dated 2026-11-16; Phys.org carried university-provided coverage on 2026-11-15, so the 16th is not treated as first publicity.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 本页保留摘要与机构解释的差别，不把葡萄残留直接等同于确认发酵酒。论文全文、污染对照和逐件判据本轮尚未完成核查，也不采用“首次证明葡萄酒祭祀”作结论。

**English.** The abstract and institutional interpretation remain distinct; grape residues are not equated with confirmed fermentation. Full-text methods, contamination controls and vessel-level criteria were not completely checked, and a first-proof-of-wine-ritual conclusion is not adopted.
